purpose: A physical model of a spring, useful in many applications. A spring is an object that will compute based upon Hooke's law. Properties only evaluate upon index making this model good for lazy applications. A good visualization can be found here, provided by Defaultio: https://www.desmos.com/calculator/hn2i9shxbz

SpringObject.luau.description: This is like a [Spring], but it can be observed, and emits events. It handles [Observable]s and Public entry points include `SpringObject.isSpringObject`, `SpringObject.ObserveRenderStepped`, `SpringObject.Observe`, `SpringObject.ObserveTarget`, `SpringObject.ObserveVelocityOnRenderStepped`, `SpringObject.PromiseFinished`, `SpringObject.ObserveVelocityOnSignal`, `SpringObject.ObserveOnSignal`.
